ModMetaData.name: Smart Haul
ModMetaData.author: Mehni
ModMetaData.description:
I like this mod v1.0! (This is fork of Pick up and Haul by Mehni)
This mod makes pawns haul things more intelligently. When hauling things to a stockpile, they will pick up all available items on the way, up to their carrying capacity. This makes hauling much more efficient. Highlight.
